title: SDG15-HND-OBSERVATIONS: interactive maps of biodiversity observations in Honduras from GBIF downloads (gbif_companion)
description: Interactive maps of biodiversity observations in Honduras (SDG 15, Life on land), built from GBIF occurrence downloads with gbif_companion. The maps show where species have been recorded, which is where people looked: an empty area means unrecorded, not absent. One config per map sets the data, theme (light or dark), colours, country, wording and credits; every build records its provenance. Maps: Don't Tell the Bees (bees of Honduras, with honey production by department) and What I Still Like to Hear (birds of Tegucigalpa over the tree canopy).
